verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs say AI reviews flag issues and suggest fixes on every PR, and that you can ask Graphite Chat for suggested fixes and apply them in one click from the review page. Direct code edits can also be made from the PR page via Agent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the review comments themselves carry committable suggestion diffs (the one-click apply is documented for Chat), evidence covering human reviewers' suggested changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
